The selected nav-rail tile is invisible in light mode (#e2e3e8 on #e7e8eb, 1.05:1); dark mode shows it (1.59:1), so the two themes differ

The search switcher's last row is cut off and faded to 4.17:1 (light), and it runs into the key-hint footer with no divider
Dark-mode Busy, DND and error red (#f58a8a) reads as salmon pink, weaker than light mode's #b42525

top_issues.issue: Card and floating-toolbar borders fall below the 3:1 non-text minimum
top_issues.evidence: Thread card and toolbar edge #b9bcc4 on #ffffff = 1.90:1 (light); #4d4f58 on #1a1b1f = 2.11:1 (dark)
top_issues.fix: Use a 'border-strong' token: light #8a8d95 (3.3:1 on #fff), dark #6b6e78 (3.1:1 on #1a1b1f) for the toolbar; for cards either use that token or drop the border and rely on a #f6f6f8 / #212227 fill

top_issues.issue: Selected nav-rail tile is invisible in light mode; selection relies only on the 3px bar and icon colour
top_issues.evidence: Tile #e2e3e8 on rail #e7e8eb = 1.05:1; dark tile #34353c on #0c0d0f = 1.59:1
top_issues.fix: Light selected tile #d6d8de (or white #ffffff with a 1px #c9cbd1 edge) to match the dark-mode prominence

top_issues.issue: Scrollbars are heavy or stray: a full-height bar on setup, solid always-on history bar, a stub inside the composer
top_issues.evidence: setup x 1272-1278 full height #717375 (light) / #959698 (dark); chats x 1272-1278 #747577 solid; composer stub x≈1167, y 712-750 next to the attach icon at x 1192
top_issues.fix: Show scrollbars only while scrolling or hovering (egui floating scroll bars), 4px wide at 40% opacity; hide on setup when content fits; move the composer bar to the inner right edge, above the action icons

top_issues.issue: Thumbnails of extreme-aspect images are unreadable strips; tiles blend into the composer
top_issues.evidence: 3072x256 shows as a 6px strip, 256x3072 as a 1px column in 144x96 tiles; tile #f0f0f2 on #ffffff = 1.13:1
top_issues.fix: Centre-crop to fill the tile (object-fit: cover) with a small aspect badge; give tiles a 1px #c9cbd1 edge; make close buttons 20px white discs with a #4a4d55 glyph and shadow

top_issues.issue: Header actions are cut off from the content column and crowded together
top_issues.evidence: Card spans x 394-1114, but the buttons sit at x 1085-1256; Copy link and Join are 4px apart
top_issues.fix: Put the actions in the same 720px column (right edge at x 1114) or below the title; use an 8px gap between buttons

top_issues.issue: Section heading spacing is inconsistent and keycaps nearly vanish
top_issues.evidence: NAVIGATION label y=165 to first keycap top y=193 (28px); APP y=349 to y=363 (14px); keycap edge #dfdfe3 on #fff 1.33:1, dark #303137 on #26272c 1.15:1
top_issues.fix: Use an 8px heading-to-row gap for every section and 20px between sections; keycap border light #b9bcc4, dark #4d4f58, fill #f3f4f6 / #34353c

top_issues.issue: Link underline is detached from the text
top_issues.evidence: Text baseline y=670, descenders to 673, underline row at y=677 (7px under the baseline)
top_issues.fix: Draw the underline at baseline +2px, 1px thick, in the link colour at 60% alpha

top_issues.issue: The last result row is half-faded and collides with the footer
top_issues.evidence: 'Noted, thanks!' row fades to #7a7c82 on #fff = 4.17:1; row bottom y≈597, key hints start y≈609 with no divider
top_issues.fix: End the list on a whole row, add a 1px #e2e3e8 divider and 8px padding above the footer; limit the fade to 12px of padding, not text

top_issues.issue: Vertical rhythm varies between similar blocks
top_issues.evidence: Settings checkbox rows at y 356/421/455/489 (hint row breaks the 34px step); setup title to body 8px vs 12px elsewhere; empty state centre y=316 here vs 340 on the other empty screens
top_issues.fix: Use a 4/8/12/16/24 scale: 12px title to body, 8px between checkbox rows, hints 4px under their checkbox; centre every empty state on the same optical line

top_issues.issue: Dark-mode danger red is salmon pink and loses its 'busy/error' meaning
top_issues.fix: Dark danger #ef6b6b (≈6:1 on #1a1b1f) for dots and text; keep a tinted #3a2427 background for failed rows

top_issues.issue: The sidebar becomes a blank column when there are no chats
top_issues.evidence: Sidebar x 64-363 has only the 'Chat' title; the filter field is removed
top_issues.fix: Keep the filter disabled and add a one-line hint 'No chats yet' in secondary 13px at the top of the list

top_issues.issue: Short conversations leave a large dead band under the header
top_issues.evidence: group-chat: header bottom y=52, first divider y=122; call-docked: blank y 132-295
top_issues.fix: Show the 'beginning of conversation' block (avatar plus chat name, 15px semibold) at the top of short histories so the space has content

top_issues.issue: Zoom mode selection is weak and the dialog lacks the file name
top_issues.evidence: Selected 'Fit' = #e2e3e8 fill on #fff (1.29:1) plus a 2px orange underline
top_issues.fix: Selected segment: white raised pill with a 1px #8a8d95 edge and 600 weight, or the accent fill; title becomes the file name, with dimensions as the subtitle

top_issues.issue: Tracking on the device code makes the hyphen read as a separate group
top_issues.evidence: 'F4KQ - 9TZW' at 30px, roughly 0.15em tracking with Inter's wide hyphen
top_issues.fix: Use tabular monospace or Inter with tnum, 0.06em tracking, and a thin space either side of an en-dash-free hyphen, or split into two boxed groups

top_issues.issue: At 760px the sidebar takes 30% of the width and names truncate hard
top_issues.fix: Below 900px shrink the list to 220px and drop the preview time into the second line, or hide the rail labels to save 16px
